doc: The 2D light model (core/render/README.md). A light is a pooled additive quad on the `light` canvas whose radial falloff is cut into `steps` flat bands with world-locked 45-degree hatching at each band edge, so it prints as paper (or an accent ink) over the charcoal streets, never as a soft 3D glow. token / alt_token are palette.json ids (alt: the strobe alternates on flicker_hz). cone_deg 0 = radial, else a cone along the light rotation. life_ticks 0 = held until removed (headlights, fire, sirens), else fades out over that many 60 Hz sim ticks. grades multiply the screen before the lights add (day = no-op). max_lights is the per-frame budget: beyond it the oldest timed light is dropped.

grades.doc: later acts: the print pushed toward the charcoal; lights cut paper back out of it

kinds.doc: a gun firing: a short paper fan along the barrel
a blast: paper core, the outer band on the vermilion plate (danger)
the police strobe: vermilion / paper (red and blue are off-doctrine; teal is the dead)
burning wreck or barrel: a flickering vermilion core
